description: Contamination, undeclared allergens, foreign matter, dangerous mislabelling, recalls or other product safety hazards.
Adulteration, substitution, counterfeit composition or concealed ingredients.
False, misleading or materially incomplete geographic-origin representations.
Misleading nutrition, health, wellness or product-benefit claims.
Child targeting, health halos or other marketing that exploits consumer misunderstanding or vulnerability.
Serving sizes, preparation directions or consumption assumptions that obscure product impact or usable value.
Reduced quantity, quality or usable value without adequate visibility to consumers.
Child labour, forced labour, unsafe work, wage abuse or worker exploitation.
Farming, handling or treatment of animals, including misleading welfare claims.
Deforestation, pollution, biodiversity loss or other material ecological damage.
Misleading environmental, sustainability or ethical representations.
Misleading pricing, promotions, unfair terms or other consumer/supplier trading practices that do not principally concern competitive market structure.
Conduct or concentrated market power that suppresses competition, excludes smaller rivals, blocks entry or unfairly squeezes suppliers and producers.
Bribery, corruption, concealment or serious governance failures.
